zh: 浦项科技大学（Pohang University of Science and Technology，简称 POSTECH）成立于1986年12月3日，是韩国第一所研究导向型私立大学。学校由韩国浦项制铁公司（POSCO）创办，被认为是仿照美国加州理工学院建立的。作为韩国工科实力最强的大学之一，POSTECH以其在科学技术领域的卓越研究和创新教育而享誉亚洲。
en: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) was established on December 3

address.zh: as South Korea's first research-oriented private university. Founded by the Pohang Iron and Steel Company (POSCO)
address.en: the university is considered to have been modeled after the California Institute of Technology. As one of South Korea's strongest universities in engineering and technology
